subject.title: feat(ui): permanent OpenClaw presence — pinned sidebar entry and Settings dock

question: Should permanent OpenClaw access preserve a custodian conversation across route re-entry, while existing saved sidebar pin choices remain untouched on upgrade?
rationale: The branch introduces a new permanent caretaker surface but currently creates a fresh page-owned conversation after navigation; whether that continuity is part of the permanent-caretaker contract requires the product owner to confirm the intended lifecycle and upgrade experience.

options.title: Preserve scoped custodian continuity
options.body: Keep one custodian session/transcript per gateway and onboarding scope across sidebar and Settings re-entry, while migrating no intentionally customized pin sets.

options.title: Make visits intentionally ephemeral
options.body: Retain fresh conversations after route re-entry and clarify in product copy and tests that the permanent entry is only a stable launch point, not a continuing caretaker thread.

recommendation.title: Preserve scoped custodian continuity
recommendation.body: Keep one custodian session/transcript per gateway and onboarding scope across sidebar and Settings re-entry, while migrating no intentionally customized pin sets.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent merged custodian onboarding work and the proposed permanent-presence behavior.
